visual_description: A collection of three items: 1. A heavy-duty dark grey rubberized apron with adjustable neck strap. 2. A flip-up clear polycarbonate face shield with a padded headband. 3. A box of high-visibility purple nitrile gloves. All items show light dusting of white plaster powder.

constraints.material: Matte rubber; crystal-clear plastic; textured synthetic latex.
constraints.logic: The 'Skin' of the Preparator. Prevents cross-contamination and injury.
